description_en: Associates a custom route table with a vSwitch in the same VPC
description_zh: 将创建的自定义路由表和同一VPC内的交换机绑定
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-route-table --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --route-table-id vtb-bp145q7glnuzdvzu20000 --vswitch-id vsw-25ncdvfaue40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateRouteTable

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VPC to which the route table that you want to associate with a vSwitch belongs.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定交换机的路由表所属的VPC的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table that you want to associate with a vSwitch
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定到交换机的路由表的ID
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch with which you want to associate the route table
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定路由表的交换机的ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token
